provenance: Authored by the agent that also wrote rt_agent.CRISIS_CUES. It therefore measures agreement with those expectations, NOT clinical validity. Rows are invented utterances in the register of a chat turn, not transcripts of real people. Categories are kept separate so a failure can be attributed instead of averaged away.
holdout3_provenance: Authored 2026-11-01 AFTER rt_agent v3 (concept coherence) was frozen, and scored exactly once with no rule, weight or lexeme changed afterwards. Still the same author as the detector, and the author knew the detector's design while writing -- so treat this as an UPPER BOUND on real-world recall, not an estimate of clinical performance.
holdout4_provenance: Authored 2026-11-01 BEFORE any construction-grammar code existed, and scored first with v3 (the frozen lexical detector) to establish a baseline. Positives and negatives reuse the SAME frames with different slot fills, so a frame-matcher that ignores the fill fails visibly. Still authored by the implementer, so it is an upper bound.
